operations.details: Verified OS coordinate tools and transformation resources.
Simple transformation rejected when sub-3m accuracy is required.
Lite OSTN/OSGM approximation not promoted to full-model accuracy.
High-accuracy transform lineage requires full OSTN15/OSGM15 semantics.
Verified OS Net RINEX product page.
RINEX 3 observation format recorded separately from derived coordinates.
Hourly publication/30-second epochs recorded as provenance only.
Centimetre-level positioning claim not applied without processing evidence.
RINEX availability cannot cancel antenna, observation or datum errors.
No synthetic coordinate or height result introduced.
Child QA only; canonical branch not mutated.
